regimens.indication: Urgent VKA Anticoagulation Reversal in Acute Major Bleeding or Urgent Surgery (Baseline INR 2 to < 4)

refs.quote: KCENTRA, (Prothrombin Complex Concentrate (Human)), is a blood coagulation factor replacement product indicated for the urgent reversal of acquired coagulation factor deficiency induced by Vitamin K antagonist (VKA, e.g., warfarin) therapy in adult patients with: acute major bleeding or need for an urgent surgery/invasive procedure.

Administer Vitamin K concurrently to patients receiving KCENTRA to maintain factor levels once the effects of KCENTRA have diminished. The safety and effectiveness of repeat dosing have not been established and it is not recommended. ( 2.1 ) Administer reconstituted KCENTRA at a rate of 0.12 mL/kg/min (~3 units/kg/min) up to a maximum rate of 8.4 mL/min (~210 units/min). ( 2.3 )

regimens.dose_text: 25 units Factor IX / kg body weight (maximum dose 2500 units, based on body weight up to 100 kg). Administer concurrent Vitamin K.

value: WARNING: ARTERIAL AND VENOUS THROMBOEMBOLIC COMPLICATIONS: Patients being treated with Vitamin K antagonists (VKA) therapy have underlying disease states that predispose them to thromboembolic events. Potential benefits of reversing VKA should be weighed against the potential risks of thromboembolic events (TE), especially in patients with the history of a thromboembolic event. Resumption of anticoagulation should be carefully considered as soon as the risk of thromboembolic events outweighs the risk of acute bleeding.

value.instructions: Do not mix KCENTRA with other medicinal products; administer through a separate infusion line. Visually inspect reconstituted solution. Administer by intravenous infusion at a rate of 0.12 mL/kg/min (~3 units/kg/min) up to a maximum rate of 8.4 mL/min (~210 units/min).

refs.quote: Do not mix KCENTRA with other medicinal products; administer through a separate infusion line. Visually inspect the reconstituted solution for particulate matter and discoloration prior to administration whenever solution and container permit. Reconstituted KCENTRA solution should be colorless, clear to slightly opalescent, and free from visible particles.
Administer reconstituted KCENTRA at a rate of 0.12 mL/kg/min (~3 units/kg/min) up to a maximum rate of 8.4 mL/min (~210 units/min). ( 2.3 )
The most common adverse reactions (ARs) (frequency ≥2.8%) observed in subjects receiving KCENTRA were headache, nausea/vomiting, hypotension, and anemia.

lactation_summary.value: No information regarding excretion in human milk; use only if clearly needed in nursing women.
